changeSet.author: josh

and.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shift_translation WHERE name = 'Morning Shift' AND language_code = 'en'

changeSet.comment: Create a default shift (Morning Shift) with translations in English, Japanese, and Thai. This shift will be used for the HQ admin user.
changeSet.sql: -- Insert default shift with explicitly generated UUID WITH new_shift AS ( INSERT INTO shift ( id, start_time, end_time, status ) VALUES ( gen_random_uuid(), '09:00:00', '17:00:00', 'ACTIVE' ) RETURNING id ) -- Insert translations for the shift using the generated ID INSERT INTO shift_translation (id, shift_id, language_code, name) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), new_shift.id, language_code, name FROM new_shift CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('en', 'Morning Shift'), ('ja', '朝シフト'), ('th', 'กะเช้า') ) AS translations(language_code, name);
